decision.rule: Score = greedy integration successes + greedy development successes - 2 x parent successes lost (greedy, both splits). The candidate is the committee if it scores at least as high as the small module, otherwise the small module. The third attempt is declared with the candidate only if it lost no parent success on either split. Otherwise there is no third attempt and the result is reported.
decision.outcome: No third attempt: the committee (59) scored below the small module (74), and the small module lost 2 parent successes on the development split.

findings.member_variance: Members trained on 690-723 sequences each solved 44, 51 and 57 of 64 integration cases; the methodology study small module solved 61 with 740.
findings.committee: The committee matched the parent outcome on 52 of 64 integration cases and failed 8 of the 53 where at least two members succeeded alone.
findings.update: The update control improved to 60 and 20 with no parent success lost (score 80).
findings.small_vs_update: The small module solved 2 integration cases the update missed and missed 4 development cases the update solved, including both lost parent successes.
